## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jun 2, 2026 - Jul 27, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Jackie Bains_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "is a scam I paid for a 28 day subscription got a 3 day and im hoping they dont charge my card again they took my money and gave me 3 days then u try to cancel the only way to cancel is to contact them so let's hope they respond but please do not fall for this scam"
            2. _Carly Strang_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "I tried it on sale and liked it but had to take a break so canceled my subscription. when I wanted to start again you had to go through the whole quiz process. they set me up with a completely different plan despite answering the same. then I got injured. well now it's a waste of money since you can only unlock a day at a time. so I messaged. they ended up canceling my subscription without asking if that's what I wanted!!!! they need jesus."
            3. _T K_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "they scam you with a free trial than, you literally cannot get ahold of them any other way than email and there they will send you in a loop making it impossible to cancel a subscription I've have lost over 400 dollars to them. they will take your money but will not make it easy to break away from them. don't get scammed like I did you are better off going on youtube for free!!! I hope this helps someone from getting scammed like I am. m"

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 23, 2026 - Jul 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Sabina Kotiranta_, May 23, 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            2. _Bartholomew Lunt_, Jul 23, 2026, 2/5: "daily work out is good but it keeps crashing and I can't track anything except the daily workout once it actually loads."
            3. _Richard Fitzgerald_, Jul 22, 2026, 2/5: "actually it it worked really great for about a month and I paid the $19.99 for the year. but I got to tell you it started getting so buggy that it stopped working and then in the middle of a workout it would stop and the sign would come on. I would say something like cancel, quit or wait and so then I would turn my phone off. turn my phone back on again and the same thing would happen and I've written letters to your company saying about all the bugs that it has and I hope that you get this stuf"
